name: Soyuz TM-31
about: Soyuz TM-31 (2000-070A), a crewed vehicle (7K-STMI), launched 2000 Oct 31. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2000 Nov 11), held fixed
docked to S26400; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
